blocks.content: Course: Rapid Build With Claude Code
SpeedBlip measures internet speed using Cloudflare's public speed test infrastructure. Three metrics are measured:

items: Download speed: Fetches a test file of known size and measures time to completion. Calculates Mbps.
Upload speed: Posts a test payload of known size and measures time to completion. Calculates Mbps.
Ping (latency): Sends an HTTP request to a Cloudflare endpoint and measures the round-trip time in milliseconds.

blocks.content: All three measurements happen inside the Web Worker. The worker posts a result message containing all three values together, plus a timestamp. The SpeedTestResult type looks like:
interface SpeedTestResult { download: number;   // Mbps upload: number;     // Mbps ping: number;       // ms timestamp: string;  // ISO 8601 id: string;         // uuid }
This result is what gets saved to localStorage, rendered in the Dashboard gauge, plotted in the History chart, and compared against the user's configured thresholds for notifications.
